strategies.name: fvg_trend_continuation_retest
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction of the trend using the fair value gap that caused a break of structure, preferably one close to an order block. Wait for price to retrace back into that bullish or bearish FVG, then enter for continuation.
strategies.exit_summary: Place the stop loss just beyond the fair value gap itself—below the FVG for buys and above the FVG for sells—and hold for continuation in the trend direction. No separate fixed target rule is taught.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to tap back into the bullish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: price will most likely come back mitigate the imbalance and keep pushing to the upside

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for price to return to the bearish FVG that caused the break of structure
variants.transcript_quote: once that FVG is created, all you just need to do is patiently wait for you know price to get back into that FVG that caused the break of structure

result.enumeration_note: The video teaches one runnable strategy: FVG trend-continuation retest. Bullish and bearish examples are direction variants of the same skeleton, not separate opposing strategies in the same context.
